title: Growth
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 46.36 Linked Discourses 46.36
  • 4. Nīvaraṇavagga 4. Hindrances

Buddhisutta Growth

“Sattime, bhikkhave, bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā buddhiyā aparihānāya saṁvattanti. “Mendicants, when the seven awakening factors are developed and cultivated they lead to growth and progress. Katame satta? What seven? Satisambojjhaṅgo …pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo. The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity. Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā buddhiyā aparihānāya saṁvattantī”ti. When these seven awakening factors are developed and cultivated they lead to growth and progress.”

Sattamaṁ.
